DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>: A named runnable configuration group. download_keys, extract_keys and prompt_keys are required dictionaries. All explicitly listed section fields are required by the constants, including filename_from_url_regex, skip_list_file and title_selectors.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys: Required. Downloader configuration block (link scraping + HTML downloads).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.download_loc: Required. Directory where downloaded HTML pages will be saved.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.download_urls: Required. List of listing/search URLs (or direct pages if follow_links=false).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.follow_links: Required. If true, scrape embedded links from each download_url; if false, download each download_url directly.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.link_selector: Required. CSS selector used to find target page links on a listing/search page.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.links_per_search: Required. Maximum number of links to collect per listing/search URL.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.download_delay: Required float, in seconds, used after listing/search pages load. It is separate from the downloader built-in random delay between individual downloads.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.filename_from_url_: Required string. Regex with a capture group used to derive a filename/skip ID from a page URL. An empty string disables ID extraction and uses an indexed fallback filename.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.skip_list_file: Required string path to a download skip-ID list, one ID per line. Use an empty string to disable it. A missing file is treated as an empty list; IDs use filename_from_url_regex when configured.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.download_keys.title_selectors: Required list of CSS selectors tried in order to produce an optional filename title suffix. An empty list disables title extraction; the base filename is still used.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.extract_keys: Required. Extraction configuration block (read saved HTML and extract structured fields).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.extract_keys.html_dir: Required. Directory containing HTML pages to extract fields from (often the same as download_loc).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.extract_keys.items_out_dir: Required. Directory where extracted items are saved as JSON files.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.extract_keys.basename_keys: Required. Item keys used to build output filenames.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.extract_keys.extract_rules: Required. Rules describing how to extract fields from HTML (CSS selectors, optional separators, and optional regex extraction).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.extract_keys.extract_rules.<fiel: Optional CSS selector; the first matching node is used. Ignored when a non-empty regex is supplied. Without either selector or regex, the field is empty.
Optional text file containing values (one per line). If the extracted field value matches any entry, the item will be skipped and no item JSON will be written.
Optional attribute name to read from the matched node instead of text content.
Optional separator used when joining extracted text content (commonly '\n').
Optional Python regex applied to raw HTML, taking precedence over css. Must contain a capture group: its first group is used, or an empty value when no match exists.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.prompt_keys: Required. Prompt generation configuration block (turn extracted items into prompts and outputs).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.prompt_keys.text_out_dir: Required. Directory where generated text outputs are saved.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.prompt_keys.prompt_template_path: Required. Path to the base prompt template file used to generate per-item prompts.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.prompt_keys.prompts_out_dir: Required. Directory where per-item prompt text files are written.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.prompt_keys.prompt_injection_key: Required list of item keys to inject into prompts. Missing keys become empty strings; this setting does not create or extract new fields.
